verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS data-activation platform like Hightouch, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, Git Sync, SDKs and an MCP server, but never an official command-line tool. Those are adjacent programmatic interfaces and earn no credit toward a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
